'''Seidhkona''' was a planet in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[mind-witch]] [[S'ybll]] used the planet as the base of her operations.
